title: Women's 5000m World Rankings: November 2026
desc: The leading ten athletes in World Athletics' women's 5000m (3000m–2 Miles–5km) event ranking as of 10 November 2026. Values are ranking points, not race times; associated 3000m, two-mile, road 5km and short-track performances can contribute. This dated top-ten snapshot is partial and the live source may change.
